remarks: Experience modern coastal luxury & everyday convenience at The Overlook, 71 Connecticut Avenue in Norwalk, CT. These refined residences feature upscale finishes, stainless-steel appliances, in-unit laundry & private balconies. Enjoy premium amenities like a fitness center, resident lounge, parking & controlled access. Perfectly positioned on Connecticut Avenue, you're moments from shops, dining, Wegmans & everyday essentials, with easy access to I-95, Route 1 & the South Norwalk train station. The vibrant SoNo district & Norwalk's waterfront attractions are just minutes away, offering the best in city-style living by the shore. Residents also benefit from free beach access to Calf Pasture & Shady Beach, ideal for morning runs, paddleboarding, or relaxing sunsets. The Overlook combines luxury, location & lifestyle for those who want it all, urban convenience, coastal charm & elevated living in one perfect address. Located on the same floor as all of the community amenities, making it easy to take advantage of everything The Overlook has to offer. This oversized unit with a balcony that stretches from the living room to the bedrooms, is unmatched. Featuring an open floor plan, primary bedroom suite, 2 spacious bedrooms, a full-sized laundry room & ample closet storage. Some images are virtually staged. Rent includes: water, trash, sewer, amenities, and 1 parking space. 2nd space $50/Parking space.
